benefits.description: $10 Quarterly DoorDash Discount (Active DashPass; Non-Restaurant Orders; through 12/31/2027)
benefits.notes: Requires an active DashPass membership and activation of the 12-month complimentary DashPass offer by December 31, 2027. One qualifying non-restaurant order per calendar quarter; unused value is forfeited and does not roll over.

benefits.description: $10 Monthly Instacart Credit (Active Instacart+ Required; through 12/31/2027)
benefits.notes: Requires enrollment and an active Instacart+ membership. Chase provides three complimentary months; the monthly credit can continue with a paid or otherwise active membership through December 31, 2027. One purchase of at least $10 per calendar month; unused value is forfeited and does not roll over.

reviewNotes: Trackable catalog scope includes only the quarterly DoorDash discount and monthly Instacart credit. Excluded as non-trackable or non-cyclical: the welcome offer, earning multipliers, Marriott Bonvoy Silver Elite status, five Elite Night Credits, complimentary subscription access itself, protections, and the Pay Yourself Back redemption cap. Global synchronization disposition: expect create actions for the new keyed card and two keyed benefits; adoption is acceptable only if a later dry-run finds an exact, bidirectionally unique unkeyed legacy match. No database synchronization is part of this change. Status materialization disposition: after a separately authorized successful sync, run insert-only materialization for missing Standard Benefit Status rows on every existing active linked Physical Card without resetting user state or cycle history. Benefit Usage Guide disposition: deferred; neither benefit has a dedicated guide, so the existing category/description fallback remains in effect. Retirement disposition: both promotions end December 31, 2027; after that date, remove them from the active static source and use these same immutable catalog keys in a reviewed synchronization that retires the definitions, creates no future statuses, and preserves prior status history.
